scope: Echo substat type selection, substat value tiers, checkpoint EXP/Tuner costs and recycle rates

sources.label: Kuro Games Korean probability disclosure (dynamic page)
Community transcription of Kuro probability disclosure

notes: Kuro's official page is dynamic; exact numeric value-tier probabilities below are taken from a public transcription explicitly sourced to that disclosure and cross-checked against current ranges.
Substat types do not repeat on one Echo. With equal base type probability, each remaining type is conditionally uniform after previously rolled types are removed.
EXP recycle is modeled as the 75% effective feed/recycle value. Direct materialization can introduce rounding; that distinction is intentionally not modeled yet.
Fresh-Echo acquisition/main-stat drop probability is outside this file and remains pending.
